steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: (In Sarkaz) Freeze.
The sound of rapid punching.

The incantation draws an invisible wall in midair, blocking every one of the Vouivre's punches. The letters abbreviating her alma mater, the Trimounts Institute of Technology, on her boxing gloves are soaked with sweat.
Finally, the Vouivre stops.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Phew—let's call it a day. Thanks for agreeing to be my practice partner, Nasti.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: We've only done half your normal routine.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: It's time for you to go. Have you said goodbye to the others?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Not yet. Maryam goes without saying; Muelsyse is in Kjerag, and I don't know the new directors of HR and Structural all that well yet.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: As for Justin Jr. and Ferdinand, I think it's better that those two see each other in private...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: They can give each other an audience to name drop fancy banquet guests, or rattle off a couple of fanciful theories that are this close to crowning a new king of science.

spans.text: They can give each other an audience to name drop fancy banquet guests, or rattle off a couple of fanciful theories that are
close to crowning a new king of science.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Besides, it's just a business trip.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: There are few things that require a business trip from the head of Engineering personally.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: The District has approved our application to consolidate resources for the Horizon Arc Project, and continue developing levitation technology based on the legacy of Galleria Stellaria.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: But they have also opened their doors to every tech firm in Columbia, designating an entire plate for the purpose.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Did you see the list of names? Administrators from the ATAO, and even Maylander.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Our proposal is now merely one of thousands. They're already showing as much respect as they could by allowing Rhine Lab to provide foundational engineering support for the plate.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Government officials, tech firm representatives... things will be very busy on the plate. You're not used to dealing with these things.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I haven't heard you complaining about anything... Control.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: The Starpod is recovering, but the eyes cast up to the sky linger. When common sense is turned upside-down, what was once ignored has naturally become the center of attention.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Naturally? Since the announcement of the Special Loan Policy, one third of major enterprises have added an aerial operations department, and SMEs are climbing over one another to jump on the 'sky fever' bandwagon.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I know what you're implying, but I'm not interested in political games.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Even if how things develop is out of our control, Rhine Lab must maintain the initiative as the original proponent, in order to protect what Kristen left behind.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: That's not so hard to understand.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Yes. Well, thanks for helping out.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: One more thing. Why did you hang a sign that says 'Components Control Section' outside your old office, instead of moving into Kristen's old room?

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: I'm used to this place.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Muelsyse asked the same question. She grabbed my arm and asked with watery eyes whether I made this choice to honor Kristen, to ensure there would always be a place for Kristen at the company.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I suppose you just feel more comfortable in your old place. You personally oversaw every little detail here, after all.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: You were watching over my shoulder the whole time I was furnishing your office. You were even more OCD than Parvis was.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: Rhine Lab is the same as it ever was.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I wouldn't quite say that. At least staff who come looking for the Control will actually find her once in a while.

steps.name: Saria
steps.text: ...I'm not sure you're the right person to say that.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Is this why you chose me for the trip?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Make a cut here. Yes, that's the right angle. That way, the branches of the main trunk will not be affected.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Test passed. Give it a tug for me before we pave it, Sky.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Next set. Light sensor performance, normal. Levitation attitude, stable. Energy input and output, check. This needs a tug, too.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Oh, and get the disassembly set from the toolbox for me as well.

steps.name: Sky?
steps.text: Do you still need the high-speed screwdriver and multi-function wrench, then?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Depends... huh? What happened to your voice?

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: I would love to help, but I have a scissor hanging from my buttons, and I'm holding five... trees? I really can't take any more.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Sorry, I'll get it. Did Sky leave?

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: He told you three times that he was going to the levitation layer for inspections. You didn't acknowledge him at all.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: You could have given me a heads-up.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: The First Rule of Secretaries: Stand to one side and smile politely, only stirring when directed by your boss, and shut your ears when the conversation turns confidential.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: I assure you I did not hear any of the figures or nouns that you just discussed, nor would I have understood a word of it.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I remember you now. You're from Administration—Gordon Tannen's secretary.

steps.name: Gentle Woman
steps.text: I'm flattered that you remember me, Director Lunorey.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: My name is Mercia. You may call me Merry. Mr. Tannen would like to invite you to lunch.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Do you manage his work inbox?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: He received your last sixteen rejections.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Then I'll get straight to the point. I know he's not interested in foundation engineering, and he knows that I have no interest in 'proposals' outside of work.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Speaking of lunch, though...

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Have you changed your mind?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: It is, indeed, time for lunch.
Nasti flips through her toolbox, taking out a rectangular object wrapped in foil from underneath all the instruments and neatly-packed toolboxes.
Mercia's curiosity brings her closer. She wants to know what could make this enigmatic director of Rhine Lab decline the most luxurious course at Cloud, the park's fine dining establishment.
A crack appears in her impeccable secretarial smile, however, as she watches Nasti impassively unwrap the object.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Is this... brick... your lunch?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: (Mumbles) Ration bar.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: What?
Mercia cannot look away from the 'brick'.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Are you hungry? Would you like a bite?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: I... I suppose. Thank you...

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: (Chews with great difficulty)

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: (Swallows arduously)

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: You didn't have to say yes.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: The Second Rule of Secretaries: Never decline an offer from your boss's guest, for even the smallest trifle might sour a relationship.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: How many rules are there?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Mr. Tannen gave me a booklet that is two centimeters thick.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: However, the most important one, and the one that I memorized first, was—

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Do whatever it takes to carry out your orders, for no one will listen to your excuses.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Don't force yourself to eat it.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Thank goodness... I mean, thank you for the hospitality.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I have a rule of my own, although it's a bit simpler.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I was born in Kazdel. The first rule I learned there is that food is precious, and no one may lie before it.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: You're holding my lunch, Mercia, so kindly tell me the truth.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: What exactly does Mr. Tannen want to 'discuss' with me?

steps.name: Tester A
steps.text: Reporting in! The core concept of this project is a perfect combination of zero-G simulation and wine tasting by substituting gravity with centrifugal force. 'You may spin, but your wine won't!'

steps.name: Tester A
steps.text: Come to the Lucky Cystybeast floating revolving bar, where it's not just the wine that makes your head spin—

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: No need to read me the marketing copy. I'm just here to assess and ask questions from an engineering perspective.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Where's the other tester? Any feedback after the rectifications?

steps.name: Tester B
steps.text: *Vomit*...
He didn't sleep well last night! We passed the re-check, didn't we, Mr. Jagger? We won't have our permit revoked?

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: The Lucky Cystybeast's floating revolving bar does not meet requirements, whether based on engineering reports or tester feedback.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: We would love to solve the technical issue of unstable power supply, but we need time...

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: You had three days, in accordance with the rules of Propeller Paradise.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: But it takes at least five days for the developers to discuss a solution!

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: Propeller Paradise has as many corporations as there are cars on the crossroads of Trimounts Square. Every driver has somewhere to be, but no one pleads to the traffic lights.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: There must be another way... I know! We hired close to a hundred testers. We could fire them and hire more researchers with the money!

steps.name: Tester A
steps.text: But you promised us yesterday—

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Shut up!

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: I've reviewed the registration details for Lucky Cystybeast.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: You were a grocer in a small town. You lack the professional knowledge for levitation technology research, even if the banks have relaxed the loan criteria for businesses in the aerial sector.

steps.name: Sky Jagger
steps.text: We stand upon Terra's first and only floating plate. Everything here must be worthy of it.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Please, don't tear off that ticket, I put my life savings into the Lucky Cystybeast, please...

steps.name: Tester A
steps.text: That's it?

steps.name: Tester A
steps.text: I'll be back to cleaning Trimounts office building windows in a couple of days?

steps.name: Tester B
steps.text: *Vomit*...

steps.name: Tester A
steps.text: Go on, barf your heart out. At least we got a taste of life in the sky... you won't have anything to throw up when you get back to the frontier, back to the cold and hunger.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Skip the technical inspections before the opening? Absolutely not.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Everyone on Propeller Paradise is racing against the clock to get across the finish line. Mr. Tannen believes that any delay to projects caused by inspections will compromise Propeller Paradise's opening.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: In addition, reducing the amount of communication you have to conduct with other tech firms will allow you to devote more of your time to your Rhine Lab research. Mr. Tannen has your best interests at heart.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: My best interests?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I spent years wandering the frontier when I first came to Columbia, building houses for the Pioneer Teams and killing bandits for the caravans. Life was hard until I finally got my big break.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: If I had someone like Gordon Tannen with my best interests at heart, handling everything I wasn't comfortable with...

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: That would have been very fortunate, I'm sure.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I would have died out there in the wilderness, I'm sure.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Besides, what he really wants isn't for Rhine to forfeit our control over technical inspections.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: How do you know?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: You imitate his negotiating style too well. The traps and pitfalls are obvious.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I'm not a Cautus. I'm not in the habit of diving into holes.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Spit it out. What does he really want?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: You are as astute and decisive as he said you were.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: In that case, I'm sure you understand that, while Mr. Tannen is in charge of Propeller Paradise's overall administration, it is Rhine that has a stranglehold on public opinion.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: He doesn't need any accidents at such a critical juncture, nor can he afford one. Therefore, he has put together a list based on project progress, and asks that you perform the inspections in this order.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: This way, at least the inspections will have a minimal impact on the progress of individual projects, and minimize the chance of conflict, setting aside the issue of engineering control.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: The less hassle for you, the less hassle for him.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: I won't try to speculate about Tannen's intentions with the order. We have a compromise.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Give me the list.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Thank you for your understanding, Director Lunorey. I won't trouble you any longer.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: One last question. Which rule were you following in the negotiation just now?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: The twelfth: Know your boss, and communicate his intentions with absolute faithfulness when negotiating, for you are his personal representative.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: However—

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Before I came, Mr. Tannen stressed how difficult the head of Rhine Lab's Engineering Section was.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: I packed blankets because I thought I might have to spend the night in front of your office.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: But that's not what I see. You don't need concern from other people, and you're used to cutting through the problem in the most direct possible way. But you still care about people.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Which is why I now have the time to enjoy my lunch in peace, something that I have not done in a long time.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Thank you.
